description: "Representative Plays by American Dramatists: 1856-1911: Rip van Winkle" by Charles Burke is a theatrical adaptation written in the mid-19th century. This work captures the essence of Washington Irving's celebrated tale, transforming it into a romantic drama featuring the iconic character Rip Van Winkle, a man who falls into a deep sleep and awakens to a changed world.
